I'll give you a metronome practice secret I picked up in college.

Take any line. For example, first 5 notes of the major scale.

Set tempo. 80 bpm.

Play it straight, 3 times. Then swing it. Then "reverse swing". Then straight again. Then increase the tempo.

So first, even 12345. Then 1 23 45. Then 12 34 5. Then 12345 again.

Notice how you get certain intervals faster and others slower in every variation with this method. It is the fastest way of training muscle memory accurately that I've used.

Increase 3 bpm only when you can do all variations accurately. If you mess up at all, slow it down 3 bpm.
